component.name: KYCVerificationWizard
component.business_context: Multi-step Know Your Customer verification process for user identity confirmation

constraints: Supported file types: PDF, JPG, PNG
Verification status options: pending review, approved, rejected

missing_states: loading (initial page load before wizard is ready)
loading (async submission between steps — e.g. uploading document to server)
error (step-level validation failure — e.g. missing required personal info fields)
error (file upload failure — e.g. network error during document upload)
error (global submission failure — e.g. API error on final submit)
empty (no file selected yet in document upload step)
disabled (Next button when required fields are incomplete)
disabled (Back button on step 1 — no previous step)
deleting (file removal after upload in document step)
rejected with reason (rejected status should surface a reason/message, not just a label)
accessibility_gaps: Stepper must use role=list with aria-current=step on the active step — ensure 'current' prop is wired to the active step id
Step transitions must announce the new step to screen readers — use an aria-live=polite region or update document title on step change
Personal info form fields (Input components) must each have a visible label and be marked required={true} where applicable
Form validation errors must be announced via aria-describedby + role=alert — use Input's built-in 'error' prop, not custom DOM
FileUpload drop zone must have role=button and be keyboard-activatable (already in DS) — confirm no custom override breaks this
Uploaded file list items must have a labelled delete/remove action — e.g. aria-label='Remove passport.pdf'
Selfie step must describe the required action in text, not image/icon alone, so screen readers can convey the instruction
Verification status (pending/approved/rejected) conveyed via Badge must NOT rely on colour alone — status label text is mandatory
Badge for 'rejected' status must be accompanied by an explanatory message so the reason is accessible, not just the badge colour
Back and Next buttons must have descriptive labels — e.g. 'Back to Personal Info', 'Next: Document Upload' rather than generic 'Back'/'Next' where context is ambiguous
Disabled Next button must still be focusable with an aria-disabled=true pattern (or tooltip) so keyboard users understand why it is inactive
Focus must be managed on step transitions — move focus to the new step heading or the top of the new step content
All Icon components used decoratively (e.g. step icons, status icons) must have aria-hidden=true
Spinner shown during async operations must have a descriptive label prop (e.g. label='Uploading document') rather than the default 'Loading'
responsive_gaps: Stepper at the top may overflow on small screens (< 375px) — ensure step labels truncate or stack gracefully
Back/Next button touch targets must be >= 44x44px on mobile — use Button with size='lg' or ensure sufficient padding
FileUpload drag-and-drop zone must degrade gracefully on touch devices where drag is unavailable — click-to-browse fallback must be prominent
Document upload preview (file name + remove action) must be readable and tappable on narrow viewports
Selfie step UI (camera preview or upload area) must be full-width on mobile to avoid cramped layout
Verification status card must stack its content vertically on small screens rather than using a horizontal layout
Wizard container should have a max-width on large screens to prevent overly wide form fields, with horizontal centering
recommendations: Use Stepper with steps=[{id:'personal-info', label:'Personal Info'},{id:'document-upload', label:'Document Upload'},{id:'selfie', label:'Selfie'}], current={activeStepId}, and status={stepStatusMap} to drive the top progress indicator
Use Input with label, required={true}, and error={fieldError} for all personal info fields (name, DOB, address, etc.) in step 1
Use Select with label, options, and onChange for any enumerated personal info fields (e.g. country, document type) in step 1
Use FileUpload with accept={['application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png']}, maxSizeMb={10}, multiple={false}, onFiles={handleFiles}, and error={uploadError} for the document upload step
Use Spinner with size='md' and label='Uploading document' inside the document upload step during async file submission
Use Spinner with size='md' and label='Submitting verification' during final step async submission
Use Skeleton with variant='rect' and appropriate width/height during initial page load while wizard config is fetched
Use Button with variant='primary' and size='md' for the Next/Submit action; set disabled={!isStepValid} and loading={isSubmitting}
Use Button with variant='secondary' and size='md' for the Back action; set disabled={activeStep === 0}
Use Card with padding='md' to wrap each step's content area for consistent spacing and visual containment
Use Card with padding='md' for the final verification status screen
Use Badge with variant='warning' and children='Pending Review' for pending status
Use Badge with variant='success' and children='Approved' for approved status
Use Badge with variant='danger' and children='Rejected' for rejected status — always accompany with a descriptive rejection reason text node
Use Modal with title='Remove Document' and open={isConfirmingRemove} and onClose={cancelRemove} to confirm file deletion in the upload step
Use IconButton with variant='ghost', aria-label='Remove [filename]', and icon=<Icon name='trash' aria-hidden={true} /> for per-file delete actions in the upload step
Use Icon with name='check' and aria-hidden={true} for decorative completion indicators on completed steps
Use Icon with name='alert' and aria-hidden={true} alongside visible text for error state indicators
